backend.acceptanceCoverage: Union of unit and integration counters for the identical application binary; individual collectors are diagnostic scopes.
backend.generatedMigrationPolicy: Report generated migrations separately; include every other application source file.
backend.requiredSeparateEvidence: Fresh PostgreSQL migrations and schema compatibility remain release obligations.

frontend.requiredSeparateEvidence: HTML templates, browser journeys and accessibility remain release obligations.

scope: 80% is required independently for backend and frontend, not a combined average or test pass rate. No unrelated application exclusions.
